patent_grounding.rationale: Modeled components, pusher contacts, work contact, staged transfers, release/detachment, and optional groove guidance agree with cited patent text. F_AXIAL now has translation-only semantics; assumptions are outside the model.

functional_completeness.rationale: Core physical elements and principal staged strokes, work clamping, release/detachment, and optional guidance behavior are present. More detailed claim 5–6 operating-position/engagement configurations are an optional detail-level enhancement, not necessary for this concept-level model.

flow_consistency.rationale: F_AXIAL denotes axial translation consistent with mechanical_linear; spring forces are separated into mechanical_force flows. Interface endpoint types and directions are compatible.

claim_traceability.rationale: Requirements and action descriptions are supported by cited claims/passages, including the larger second spring constant; no unsupported quantitative or executable constraints are introduced.

interfaces.rationale: Interfaces reference existing ports and flows with compatible types/directions. External rod, protrusion, and work/pallet are separate context components; connections are recorded once.

textbook_application.rationale: Context/interface guidance supports external context separation and boundary interactions; functional-allocation guidance is consistent with the physical subsystem decomposition. Irrelevant state-modeling retrieval is not used as factual support.

findings.description: The model omits claim 5's four named operating positions and claim 6's groove and small-diameter/unlocking-segment engagement configurations. Core staged strokes and release are represented; this remains an optional completeness enhancement at the present abstraction level.
findings.recommendation: Optionally add concise, supported position/configuration descriptions for claim-level completeness, without inventing transition triggers or guards.

summary: Revision 5 resolves the prior F_AXIAL semantic inconsistency: its translation-only name and notes distinguish it from the separate spring-force flows. Actual cited patent passages and relevant textbook guidance were checked. The model's core evidence, interfaces, types/directions, and traceability are coherent, with no structural findings or actionable unresolved warnings/errors. Only an informational claim 5–6 position/configuration detail omission remains. Candidate not edited.
